info.description: Every response states how far its content can be trusted and where it came from. The API has no mutation authority: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are the only methods it routes, and it reads a published dataset rather than any canonical store. Records are served from a content-addressed dataset whose identity appears in every response.

excluded_domains.reason: Discovery signals are untrusted community observations awaiting corroboration and review. Publishing them beside reviewed knowledge would make untrusted material look like an answer, so this release publishes none of them.
A finding is a rule applied to one project's evidence. Publishing it would turn one project's state into a claim about Drupal.
A finding is a rule applied to one project's evidence. The reviewed rule behind it is published instead.
Migration work items name files and lines in one project. The authoritative deprecation records behind them are published instead.
Evidence describes one repository at one revision. It answers a local question and is never global Drupal content.
A remediation plan is computed for one project's installed versions. The advisories behind it are published instead.
An upgrade assessment is bounded by one project's evidence and is not a statement about Drupal.
